test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 07 March 2023)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The story of his uncle’s mysterious disappearance was first heard by Rajat in his childhood

options.text: The story uncle heard first time was about Rajat’s mysterious disappearance in his childhood.
Rajat first heard the story of his uncle’s mysterious disappearance in his childhood.
The story Rajat first heard in his childhood was about his uncle’s mysterious disappearance.
Rajat’s first story that uncle heard in his childhood was about his mysterious disappearance.

solution:
Here the correct answer is** 2) Rajat first heard the story of his uncle's mysterious disappearance in his childhood.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This sentence is in **passive voice** as the subject** (the story)** is receiving the action (was first
